body:
#### Reference Issues/PRs
Fixes #35038.

#### What does this implement/fix? Explain your changes.
`HalvingGridSearchCV` and `HalvingRandomSearchCV` were added to `__all__` in #31847, but the module's `__getattr__` raises `ImportError` for them until `enable_halving_search_cv` is imported, so `from sklearn.model_selection import *` fails. This drops them from `__all__` and keeps the `TYPE_CHECKING` import (with `# noqa: F401`), matching 1.7.2. Explicit access still raises the guidance error, and the estimators are still importable after `enable_halving_search_cv`.

Added `test_star_import_public_modules` in `sklearn/tests/test_common.py`, which star-imports every public module in a fresh interpreter. It needs a subprocess because `test_common.py` itself imports `enable_halving_search_cv`, which is also why `test_import_all_consistency` didn't catch this. It fails on main and passes with the fix; model_selection is currently the only public module affected.

#### Introduce yourself
I'm a CS student and regular scikit-learn user, mostly through model_selection. I hit this while star-importing the module in a notebook.
title: FIX restore star-import of sklearn.model_selection
